caution.title: Read this first
caution.body: DogeDrop has not been audited. Be careful. Test with a small amount only. A payment cannot be undone, and coins can be lost if something goes wrong.
access.title: Use the same wallet here
access.body: Browsers keep an embedded wallet separate until you allow it. Allowing it lets this page open the wallet you already created, instead of making a new one.
access.openTab: Open the wallet in its own tab
access.openTabHint: if the browser asks you to visit it first.
access.denied: The browser did not share the wallet. Open it in its own tab once, then come back and try again.
welcome.title: DogeDrop stays with you
welcome.body: Your wallet, your keys. Stored securely in this browser.
create.passwordHelp: This password locks the wallet on this browser. It is not sent anywhere. The 12 words, which come next, are what can restore the coins on another computer.
create.passphraseHint: Leave this empty unless you already use a BIP39 passphrase.
create.revealHelp: This is the only backup. If you lose the words, the coins cannot be recovered by anyone. The next step asks for three of them.
create.confirmDisclaimer: I understand nobody, including this website, can restore the words for me.
create.passwordTooShort: Use a password of at least 8 characters.
create.wordsMismatch: The words do not match your written copy yet.
create.created: This browser now has your wallet.
create.createdWithBackup: This browser now has your wallet. Keep the 12 words somewhere safe.
create.recoveryFileWarning: Anyone with these words can spend the coins. Keep them offline.
restore.title: Restore a wallet
restore.passphraseHint: Only if you created the phrase with a passphrase.
restore.invalidWords: Those words are not a valid recovery phrase.
network.vmHelp: DogecoinVM is a separate network. Coins are not shared with Dogecoin.
network.vmDisabled: DogecoinVM is disabled in this wallet.
network.choose: Choose Dogecoin or DogecoinVM. The same address is not the same coins.
network.linkSelected: Network selected by the payment link.
network.checkSelection: Make sure you select the correct network.
network.dogeWait: A Dogecoin confirmation usually takes 1 to 10 minutes.
network.vmWait: A DogecoinVM payment is final in about a fifth of a second.
network.historyUnavailable: Activity could not be refreshed. Showing the last saved payments. The balance is current.
network.offlineCached: The network did not answer ({error}). Showing the last saved balance and activity.
send.title: Send
send.feeHint: Left is cheaper. This is the fee for a simple payment.
send.remainder: Small remainder included in the network fee.
send.typeAddressToDelete: Type the current receive address to remove the wallet from this browser.
receive.title: Receive
activity.title: Activity
activity.noHistoryNode: A node can find coins to spend, but it does not keep an address history.
activity.empty: No payments found for this wallet yet.
settings.title: Connection
settings.broadcast: Where to send the signed payment
settings.deleteExplanation: Removing the wallet from this browser does not move the coins. Type the receive address to confirm.
settings.removed: The wallet was removed from this browser. The coins are still safe if you kept the 12 words.
approval.signExplanation: {site} wants a signature from your wallet. This does not spend coins.
approval.connectExplanation: {site} wants to see your Dogecoin address and ask before each payment. It cannot see your recovery phrase.
payment.chooseChainLink: Choose a chain in the payment link
payment.replaceWarning: Creating or importing replaces the wallet in this browser. The coins stay safe only if you kept the 12 words.
payment.noWallet: This browser does not have a DogeDrop wallet yet.
payment.externalDoge: This opens a dogecoin: link for a wallet already installed on this device. DogeDrop does not sign that payment.
payment.externalVm: This opens a dogecoinvm: link for a wallet already installed on this device. DogeDrop does not sign that payment.
payment.siteAsks: {site} is asking for a payment, and DogeDrop is not connected.
payment.externalContinue: Continue in your other wallet. DogeDrop did not send this payment.
debug.sameOrigin: This site is hosting the wallet itself, so its scripts can reach the wallet. For a real integration, load the wallet from its own address.
noscript: DogeDrop needs JavaScript. It still keeps the keys in your browser.
